text:
mele: Starting follow-up for the postmortem: we need a compact owner map, short mitigations, and a recurrence monitoring plan. Please ack + which item you take.

diego: Ack. Can you list the discrete actionables so I can slot them into my sprint?

mele: Pulled items: (1) cross-region routing fallback + canary guard, (2) model-registry client resilience (retries + CB + cached manifests), (3) auth-provider token single-flight + refresh healthcheck, (4) vendor escalation card + SLA ask + legal draft, (5) monthly incident-pattern dashboard + weekly digest, (6) post-deploy smoke that includes registry+auth.

rinna: I'll take (2). Proposal: add exponential backoff with jitter, circuit-breaker that opens on 6xx burst (>=4 in 45s), plus a small redis-backed manifest cache with 2m TTL. ETA: feature branch by 2026-03-30. Will add integration tests that fake 502/503 responses.

mele: @rinna assign. Make sure the cached manifest includes schema version so we handle incompatible manifests safely.

rinna: Good call. I'll version the cache entry.

diego: I'll own (1) and (6) together. Plan: gateway policy to route to secondary region when p75 latency > 350ms for 2m OR 5xx rate > 1.5%. Include canary toggle and per-route metrics. Add a post-deploy smoke job that runs 8 registry+auth checks and blocks the rollout if >2 failures or >450ms median. ETA: config PR + smoke job by 2026-04-04.

sam: I'll take (3) token single-flight and refresh healthcheck. Implement single-flight mutex per-key, add a synthetic token-refresh probe every 45s, and a fail-open window of 30s to avoid global outage. ETA: 2026-03-26.

infra-bot: Follow-up ticket created INC-2026-742 and linked to the incident board.

vendor-eng: For (4) I'll add primary + backup escalation contacts for provider-Z and request a dedicated P1 path. I'll also draft suggested "incident credit" wording and share with legal. ETA: contacts + draft by 2026-03-24.

mele: For the monthly pattern dashboard (5), we need a Grafana panel that aggregates upstream vendor incidents, affected services, and recurrence counts over 30/90/180d. Who can own?

diego: I'll create staging panel and a query for the postmortem DB. ETA: 2026-04-01. I'll also wire an automated weekly digest that posts summary to #incidents.

rinna: Ops note: when serving cached manifests, emit structured telemetry: event=serve_cached_manifest, reason, cached_age_ms, route, owner_team. That will help trend analysis.

sam: Add logging when token refresh fails and we enter fail-open; emit event=token_fail_open, duration_s, affected_nodes.

mele: Contract/legal: vendor-eng + legal to coordinate. Please include a clause for repeated availability misses and a contact escalation matrix (primary, secondary, engineering manager).

vendor-eng: Will loop legal. I'll also ask the vendor for weekly postmortem meetings for the next 2 months.

diego: Risk note for cross-region routing: we must ensure consistent model artifact availability; add a reconcile job that verifies artifact checksums after a failover window. I'll include that in the gateway PR.

rinna: For model-registry client tests, I'll add a harness that replays latency spikes and partial auth failures so we validate cache correctness and CB behavior.

mele: Recap owners/ETAs: rinna (registry resilience + cached manifests + tests) -> 2026-03-30; sam (token single-flight + healthcheck) -> 2026-03-26; diego (routing + smoke + dashboard + reconcile) -> 2026-04-01/2026-04-04; vendor-eng (contacts + SLA/legal draft) -> 2026-03-24.

infra-bot: Reminder: INC-2026-742 triage check in 48h.

rinna: Draft PR pushed (wip): https://git.internal/p/registry-resilience-wip

sam: Token single-flight RFC up: https://git.internal/p/token-rfc (needs review).

diego: Gateway policy PR + smoke job queued for review.

vendor-eng: Contact card added to INC-2026-742 and vendor outreach scheduled.

mele: Thanks. Please add PR/ticket links to INC-2026-742 and react with :white_check_mark: when linked. We'll review progress in the weekly triage; escalate any ETA slips asap.
